name: Sanctuary AI
tagline: Phoenix, a general-purpose humanoid robot driven by the Carbon AI control system.
description: Sanctuary AI builds Phoenix, a general-purpose humanoid robot for work, powered by Carbon, a hybrid cognitive control system that blends symbolic reasoning, large language models, and reinforcement learning to mimic human cognitive subsystems. Phoenix features highly dexterous hands and can be taught new tasks in under 24 hours.

modelSupport.notes: Hybrid cognitive architecture: symbolic reasoning + LLMs + RL.
